text:
bench-bot: CI perf alert: nightly-smallbatch latency regression +78% on 3160012345 (driver 12.16.1 rollout)
sam: seeing it locally too on a100-rtpool. smallbatch p99 jumped from 68ms -> 121ms :eyes:
liz: any recent merges touching prefetch/evict logic? I recall a scheduling tweak yesterday.
matt: merged: 7f3a2c4 (triton: async-evict-scheduler) and 2b9d8f1 (runtime: prefetch heuristics). both went out in canary last night.
anita: quick profile (nvprof + pprof) attached below — KV evict spikes line up with requests for sequence_len<=8

```
PROFILE SNAPSHOT 3160012380
alloc/free: stable
kv_evictions/sec: 420 -> 3200
prefetch_attempts/sec: 120 -> 380
kernel_dispatch: conv_v1 45% -> conv_v2 40% -> matmul_fallback 15% -> matmul_fallback 30%
cpu->gpu memcpy stalls: 0.8ms -> 3.4ms
```

jordan: interesting — kernel selector seems to flip to fallback matmul more often; could be scheduler preemption interleaving small batches.
sam: repro script:
```
./perf/run_smallbatch.sh --model gpt-small --seq 8 --batch 2 --iters 500
```

sam: repro shows step latency distribution with periodic 5-10ms spikes every ~30s.
liz: I ran a bisect pinned to older driver and older triton: when we run with driver 12.15.x + triton before 7f3a2c4 the spikes disappear.
matt: so likely interaction between driver 12.16.1 and the new async-evict-scheduler change.
anita: any logs from device that show preemption or context-switch? nvml shows preempt counter bumps aligning with evict bursts.

matt: quick mitigation: rollback 7f3a2c4 on canary and re-run smoke. if perf recovers, we can land a more conservative variant.
liz: +1. also we should pin driver rollout until we confirm.
sam: will open a revert PR and deploy to canary pool. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/842

deploy-bot: started canary deploy of runtime@revert-7f3a2c4 to rtpool-canary (3 nodes)

anita: after revert canary results: p99 smallbatch 70ms -> 72ms (within noise). eviction/sec back to ~430.
jordan: CI nightly after revert passed perf gating for smallbatch. close to baseline.
matt: ok we're unblocking driver rollout, but still need root cause. adding to follow-up: "async-evict + driver scheduler interaction" and a deeper trace task.

sam: notes for root cause triage:
- reproduce on 12.16.1 with and without 7f3a2c4
- gather kernel dispatch logs with timestamps
- run with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all and with different GPU concurrency to stress preemption
- capture hw preemption counters via nvidia-smi and perf

liz: assign to matt + anita. set priority P0 for next sprint; this blocks Dedicated rollout in eu-west until driver pinned.
matt: creating perf issue and tagging infra/driver. Issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1209

bench-bot: CI summary after revert: smallbatch latency delta -75% vs failing run, kv_evictions back to baseline, canary healthy :white_check_mark:

sam: thanks folks. follow-up: add a guard to async-evict that disables aggressive preempt buckets when driver reports preempt-support flag X (to avoid thrash). will draft RFC.

liz: and add unit for selector hysteresis so it doesn't flip kernels for short-run sequences.

matt: set rollback as postmortem action item. we'll keep driver rollout paused for 24h.

deploy-bot: driver rollout paused for region eu-west (per @liz)

anita: cc @security — no customer data path change, just perf. leaving logs in S3: s3://redwood-inference/perf/3160012345/

sam: closing thread for immediate rollback. opening thread INF-1209 for root cause deep-dive. :lock:
